principle_violations.reason: The `sum` method in `AreaCalculator` uses `instanceof` to determine the shape type and calculate the area. This violates the open/closed principle because adding a new shape like Triangle would require modifying this method.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface or abstract class `Shape` with a method `area()`. Make each shape class implement this interface or extend the abstract class and implement the `area` method.
